exposure: Placenta previa types (I, II, III, IV)
cohort: The study included 80 pregnant women hospitalized to the obstetrics department for labor with a confirmed diagnosis of placenta previa, including partial or total placenta previa.
finding: The study found that placenta previa significantly impacts maternal and newborn health, with Type IV being the most dominant type, and was associated with high rates of premature delivery (53.7%), low birth weight (53.7%), and NICU admissions (4%) among infants.
birth_weight: 53.7% of infants had low birth weights.
